One picture for the whole incident.

ArcHorizon connects command decisions, team assignments, maps, field updates, and records in one incident workspace. Everyone works from information that moves with the operation.

Explore all featuresSee the field app
A shared operating picture

Information that stays connected.

A clue changes a search area. A hazard changes an assignment. A team update changes the operational picture. ArcHorizon keeps those records connected so command, planning, and field personnel can act on the same information.

Where it works

Built for SAR. Useful wherever people coordinate a response.

ArcHorizon supports search and rescue, public safety incidents, and planned events. Incident command principles provide the structure; teams can adapt their operational picture to the work in front of them.

Explore operations →
Open source & adaptable

Make the platform fit your operation.

ArcHorizon is planned for open-source release so organizations can adapt forms, map sources, workflows, and integrations to their own work.
